messages:
People Ops: Quick heads-up — we're reorganizing Platform Product into two focused teams: Serving Platform and Developer Experience. This is to improve velocity on serving optimizations and make DevEx a first-class partner for customer onboarding. Main changes below.

People Ops: Leadership changes: Noah Patel is joining as Director, Serving Platform (starts May 5). Carmen Ruiz will be promoted to Head of Developer Experience (effective Apr 20). Priya will remain VP of Platform and own cross-team roadmaps and SLAs.

Priya Natarajan: Welcome Noah!! :tada: Noah will own GPU runtime, autoscaling, and model-serving contracts. Carmen will own SDKs, docs, console UX, and rollout tooling.

Noah Patel: Really excited to join — thanks everyone. My first priority is hauling down tail-latency on 512+ token generations. I want to meet runtime + infra leads this week.

Carmen Ruiz: Grateful for the trust. Immediate focus: DevEx hiring pipeline (senior docs engineer + SDK lead) and improving onboarding playbooks for Dedicated/Private customers.

Jordan Kim: Any changes to reporting lines for capacity or infra? We should call out on-call and pager rotations.

Priya Natarajan: Good Q. Capacity and Eng-Infra remain in Eng infra org. Serving Platform will have a dotted line to Eng infra for capacity planning. We'll keep current on-call assignments for 2 weeks while we finalize handoffs.

Allison Chen: Can People Ops post a short org chart + who to ping for new hires? New recruiters are asking.

People Ops: Yep — attached below (simple ascii for quick skim). Full org doc will follow in Confluence.

People Ops: ```
Platform (Priya N.)
├─ Serving Platform (Noah P.)
│  ├─ Runtime & Kernels
│  ├─ Serving Orchestration
│  └─ Model Onboarding (coord w/ Applied ML)
└─ Developer Experience (Carmen R.)
   ├─ SDKs & CLI
   ├─ Docs & Quickstarts
   └─ Console UX & Rollouts
```

Mariam Okoye: Noted. We'll open reqs for the two DevEx roles Carmen flagged and reassign a recruiter to Noah's searches tomorrow.

Noah Patel: Quick ask — can somebody share the latency dashboards (last 30 days) and current canary policy? I'll read up before 1:1s.

Priya Natarajan: @Allison Chen will drop the dashboards. Canary policy doc is at /docs/rollouts/canary-policy.md (internal).

Allison Chen: Dropping dashboards here: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/latency-serving (team access). Also pinged observability to add Noah to viewer group.

Jordan Kim: For transparency, do we want a short announcement to customers about the split or keep it internal?

Priya Natarajan: Keep internal for now. We'll craft customer-facing messaging only if it impacts support or SLAs.

Carmen Ruiz: Hiring priorities: 1) SDK lead 2) Senior docs engineer 3) Product manager (DevEx). I'll add role briefs to the hiring tracker today.

HiringBot: Reminder: create reqs in Greenhouse within 48 hours for any role with a new owner.

People Ops: Action items: 1) People Ops to publish full org doc by EOD Fri. 2) Recruiters assigned to DevEx & Serving searches. 3) Noah & Carmen to run 30/60/90 outlines and share with Priya. 4) Keep current on-call for 2 weeks.

Noah Patel: Sounds good. 1:1s next week are great — I'll book time with runtime and infra leads.

Priya Natarajan: Thanks all — excited for the focus. :rocket:
